name: HENCHMEN WITH SERIOUS INJURIES

textFormat.ruleText: Original wording from the user-supplied PDF, with layout line breaks removed.

ruleText: Henchmen who are out of action at the end of the battle are removed permanently from the roster sheet on a D6 roll of 1-2. They have either suffered severe injuries, died of their wounds, or decided to quit the warband. On a roll of 3-6 they can fight in the next battle as normal.

results.name: Removed from Warband
results.ruleText: Henchmen who are out of action at the end of the battle are removed permanently from the roster sheet on a D6 roll of 1-2. They have either suffered severe injuries, died of their wounds, or decided to quit the warband.

results.name: Full Recovery
results.ruleText: On a roll of 3-6 they can fight in the next battle as normal.

notes: Roll once for each affected model, not once for its entire Henchman group.
Surviving Henchmen do not use the Hero injury table or receive permanent stat reductions under this core rule.
The Henchman paragraph does not specify equipment disposition for a removed model; equipment-loss rules are not inferred from the separate Hero death result.
This file represents the core Henchman rule only, without warband exceptions, errata or house rules.
